final_target: ICStudio 1.0 as defined by AGENTS.md M8
assessment: M0 is accepted. A substantial M1 headless foundation is accepted on commit c63c0b87c958bb11ce9c49a2b18851fd0075f96a by GitHub Actions run 30774870611: authoritative project hierarchy, revision-safe transactions, deterministic persistence, crash recovery, exact integer rectangles, a million-shape spatial-index baseline, typed worker envelopes, process crash isolation, and equivalent CLI/MCP project summaries. M1 is not complete because the desktop shell, UI state consumer, PDK base, netlist IR, result DB, and GDSII/SPICE parser scaffolds are not implemented.

milestones.name: Design kernel and headless skeleton
evidence: Project create/save/reopen hierarchy test passed on Linux macOS and Windows
One-million-shape geometry baseline passed on Ubuntu release build
Worker crash isolation passed on Linux macOS and Windows
CLI and MCP project state/revision equivalence passed
Project and RPC version-1 schemas published

known_risks: The bootstrap MCP decoder is deliberately minimal and not a general JSON implementation
The release-build workflow defines native targets but has not yet been exercised by a version tag
The reference spatial index has deterministic semantics but is not yet a production R-tree or hierarchical layout index
Project metadata replacement relies on the ready journal for recovery across the remove-and-rename window
No desktop UI consumes authoritative snapshots yet
No PDK runtime, netlist IR, result database, GDSII parser, or SPICE parser exists
No schematic, layout, simulation, verification, extraction, EM, thermal, photonic, optimization, or tapeout capability exists
